description: This file contains functions for seeding a database with roles, skills, and related data for a career pathway navigator application. It includes logic for creating or updating skills and roles, attaching skills to roles with levels, and ensuring idempotent dataset initialization.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: Model representing a skill in the database.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Model representing a role in the database.

methods.name: _ensure_skills
methods.description: Creates or fetches skills based on provided specifications, filling in missing category or description fields.

methods.name: _attach_role_skills
methods.description: Attaches or updates skills to a role with specified levels, computes gap annotations, and adds optional recommendations.

methods.name: seed_minimal_dataset
methods.description: Seeds the database with core roles, extended roles, skills, and initial progress data.

methods.name: seed_minimal_dataset_idempotent
methods.description: Performs an idempotent seed of roles, skills, and mappings, safe to run multiple times.
